messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Shiny 0.2.0 released
parts:
I've just pushed another build of Shiny: v0.2.0. This will hopefully be the first version that goes to CRAN, so I'd appreciate it if you could all install it and let me know if it breaks any of your applications.

install.packages('shiny', repos=c('http://rstudio.org/_packages', 'http://cran.rstudio.com'))

Some highlights from the last ten days of updates (includes versions 0.1.9 through 0.2.0):
  • On-the-fly file downloads are now supported! You can easily make your in-memory data available as a .csv, for example. More details
  • Fixed bug where runGist would download but not uncompress gists on Windows.
  • reactiveTable passes options to both xtable and print.xtable calls, enabling far more formatting options.
  • reactivePlot can now be dynamically sized, by using a function for height instead of a numeric value.
  • IE8 is now supported (Shiny hosting service only).
Thanks for testing!

install.packages('shiny', repos=c('http://rstudio.org/_packages', 'http://cran.rstudio.com'))

Some highlights from the last ten days of updates (includes versions 0.1.9 through 0.2.0):
  • On-the-fly file downloads are now supported! You can easily make your in-memory data available as a .csv, for example. More details
  • Fixed bug where runGist would download but not uncompress gists on Windows.
  • reactiveTable passes options to both xtable and print.xtable calls, enabling far more formatting options.
  • reactivePlot can now be dynamically sized, by using a function for height instead of a numeric value.
  • IE8 is now supported (Shiny hosting service only).
Thanks for testing!

Another thing to try to get more diagnostic information:

File -> Quit R
Start new R session
Upload file as described previously
Help -> Diagnostics -> Request log

This will show you RStudio's event log. There will be one event called "get_events" with a long bar.  If you click on that, it should give you some information about the attempted upload. Mine also has one labeled "complete_upload" with other infomration, but I'm guessing you won't have that.

-Winston
